findings3: GAP-FCT-02 (CONFIRMED WITH A PASSING CONTROL): round 2 introduced five resolution `method` values - comply(17) expose(10) lie(7) sabotage(3) investigate(1) - that are NOT in RES_METHODS_NONVIOLENT (game/src/sim/quest/defs.js:27). That set is the build's only guard against a resolution declaring a non-violent method while demanding violence (defs.js:113). 38 of 87 round-2 faction resolutions = 43.7% carry an unknown method; all 38 unknown-method resolutions IN THE WHOLE GAME (383) are this round's. INSTRUMENT TEST: set violence_required:true on Q-LEDG-13.res_will_not_witness (method refuse, KNOWN) -> QuestBook throws, guard RED. Same mutation on Q-LEDG-13.res_renew_it (method comply, UNKNOWN) -> QuestBook clean, guard GREEN. The r2 status file's 'check-quests 120 quests PASS' is partly vacuous.

AR-3 BIGGEST FINDING: game/data/crime/sanction.json faction_law_factor.standing_ids has 7 entries. FOUR of them - the_ninth_cohort, the_morag_tong, shadowscale_order, the_sap_cutters - appear in ZERO quest files and have no joins_faction anywhere. deep_kin has quests but no join path. And THE IMPERIAL ASSIZE IS NOT IN THE MAP AT ALL, nor are the_ixtu_vakh or the_dockhands (both joinable via Q-MAIN-19/21). Only 2 of the 5 joinable factions are wired.

AR-3 SPREAD RE-DERIVED INDEPENDENTLY: standingKey() (sim/crime/sanction.js:137) can only return a row for a standing syncFactionStandings() wrote, which requires membership AND presence in standing_ids. Reachable imperial_law values by play: none 1.0, wet-ledger:1-2 1.25, wet-ledger:3+ 1.75, xul-aneekh:1-3 0.65, xul-aneekh:4+ 0.45. REACHABLE SPREAD = 1.75/0.45 = 3.89x, not the declared 5.33x. The 2.4 top row (ninth-cohort:4+) is UNREACHABLE BY CONSTRUCTION, not merely 'not walked to' as the builder frames it. I also reproduced the builder's 1.92x exactly: 1.25/0.65 = 1.923 (both lines at derived rank 1-2). A player who walks the ASSIZE to rank 7 moves no arrest threshold at all - standing stays 'none', factor 1.0.

findings4_DECISIVE: GAP-FCT-03 — THE BIGGEST GAP. I re-ran the BUILDER'S OWN probe unchanged on the current build: `node tools/quests/faction-probe.mjs --line the_wet_ledger`. It goes from the 16/16 recorded in reports/faction-probe-the_wet_ledger.json to 8/16. Every round-2 headline collapses: P3 7/18 quests offerable (was 18/18); P4 top derived rank 4 not 7; P13 the seat is NOT vacated by play; P14 rank7+non-violent together FAIL; P15 17 questOpen calls refused; and P16 - the round's strongest claim - now reads 'the walk WROTE reputation 10, 22, 36, 52, 70, 90, 112' where the on-disk report says 'the walk wrote no reputation at all; 398 was paid entirely by the quests own consequences'.

CAUSE: game/src/sim/quest/machine.js:472 now refuses open() when the giver is not in the running world - `giver absent: factor-belliene is not in this world`, gate 'giver_presence', presenceMode defaults to 'on' (machine.js:93). It landed in commit d3e4830/e7ed252 ('The player can learn the words and has nobody to say them to') AFTER the faction round-2 measurements were taken. NEITHER faction-probe.mjs NOR faction-seam-probe.mjs calls questPresenceGate, so neither can suspend it.

This is the CONSUMPTION failure ARBITRATION s3 describes, at the top level: 54 faction quests, 1005 journal entries, three ladders - and the running world contains nobody to give them. All 51 givers DO exist in game/data/npcs/** (336 npc ids); they are not SPAWNED. quest-givers.json holds only 19 npcs.

The reputation cascade is causal, not coincidental: because open() refuses, faction-probe's grantRep() fallback fires to satisfy rank terms, so P16 goes red. The 'no reputation writes' claim was true only while every quest opened.

records_belief: r1 19.7% -> r2 56.8% of journal entries. Under a deliberately GENEROUS first-person-epistemic-marker test the correspondence between the flag and the text FELL from 37.0% to 13.4%. No checker anywhere validates records_belief against the text - it is a self-declared authorial boolean that RI-QST02 scores on. Unfalsifiable metric.
